title: 不经过 Shell 查看 Git 状态
使用结构化字段查询 Windows 系统信息
content: {"command":"$os = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem -ErrorAction Stop; $computer = Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem -ErrorAction Stop; [pscustomobject]@{ OSName = $os.Caption; OSVersion = $os.Version; OSArchitecture = $os.OSArchitecture; SystemType = $computer.SystemType } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress","shell":"powershell","timeout_seconds":30}
